paper_metadata.title: Marco-o1: Towards Open Reasoning Models for Open-Ended Solutions
paper_metadata.abstract: Currently OpenAI o1 sparks a surge of interest in the study of large reasoning models (LRM). Building on this momentum, Marco-o1 not only focuses on disciplines with standard answers, such as mathematics, physics, and coding -- which are well-suited for reinforcement learning (RL) -- but also places greater emphasis on open-ended resolutions. We aim to address the question: ''Can the o1 model effectively generalize to broader domains where clear standards are absent and rewards are challenging to quantify?'' Marco-o1 is powered by Chain-of-Thought (CoT) fine-tuning, Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), reflection mechanisms, and innovative reasoning strategies -- optimized for complex real-world problem-solving tasks.

extraction_data.innovation: Integrates Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with step-level and mini-step actions to explore a broader solution space for correct answers; refines reward signals via Outcome Reward Modeling (ORM) and Process Reward Modeling (PRM) to reduce randomness; applies reinforcement learning to fine-tune decision-making processes for complex real-world tasks.
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with CoT data, followed by MCTS-based inference-time search and reflection., Reinforcement learning fine-tuning for decision-making processes
extraction_data.research_problem: Enhancing large reasoning models (LRMs) to tackle complex, real-world open-ended problems where clear standards are absent and rewards are hard to quantify.
extraction_data.application: Mathematics, physics, coding, open-ended problem solving, machine translation, multilingual reasoning.
extraction_data.paper_title: Marco-o1: Towards Open Reasoning Models for Open-Ended Solutions
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Open-O1 CoT Dataset (Filtered), Marco-o1 CoT Dataset (Synthetic), Marco Instruction Dataset
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Full-parameter fine-tuning on Qwen2-7B-Instruct with filtered Open-O1 CoT dataset and synthetic Marco-o1 CoT dataset -> MCTS integration for solution space expansion -> Reasoning action strategies and reflection mechanism.
